mapper.insert: INSERT into chat_window(id,seller,buyer,goods_id,goods_price,goods_send,goods_freight,last_time) SELECT #{id},#{seller},#{buyer},#{goodsId},goods.price,goods.send,goods.freight,NOW() from goods WHERE id=#{goodsId}
mapper.select: SELECT cw.id, cw.buyer, cw.seller, cw.goods_id, cw.last_time, cw.goods_price, cw.goods_freight, cw.goods_send, bu.head_url as buyer_head, su.head_url as seller_head, su.account as seller_account, bu.account as buyer_account, gi.image_url as goods_image, g.stock as goods_stock FROM chat_window as cw JOIN goods as g ON g.id=cw.goods_id JOIN `user` as bu ON cw.buyer = bu.id JOIN `user` as su ON cw.seller = su.id JOIN ( SELECT gi.goods_id, MIN(gi.image_order) as min_image_order FROM goods_images gi GROUP BY gi.goods_id ) as gi_min ON gi_min.goods_id = cw.goods_id JOIN goods_images as gi ON gi.goods_id = gi_min.goods_id AND gi.image_order = gi_min.min_image_order WHERE cw.buyer = #{userId} OR cw.seller = #{userId};
